proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL kavāṭa includes kapāṭa leaf of a door and Prakrit kavāḍa/kavāla/kiviḍī, then Bihari kewāṛī, Maithili kebāṛ/kebāṛī, Hindi kiwāṛ/kiwār/kewār and Gujarati kamāṛ. These support the selected velar-initial labial-medial door family, including conservative kapat/kabat forms and rhotic kiwara/kebari forms. Labial voicing, dental/retroflex notation and vowels remain as transcribed. Learned or cross-IA transmission is unresolved; the entry explicitly reports some IA borrowing and proposes a deeper Dravidian origin without establishing it. Exact response: kʸevar.
